description: This file is a Python script that generates C++ code for Google Mock (GMock) mutants, including templates and functions for creating functors and dispatching method calls, primarily used for testing purposes.

classes.name: MutantRunner
classes.description: Interface for executing methods with parameters.

classes.name: Mutant
classes.description: Holds pre-bound arguments and allows call-time arguments for method invocation.

classes.name: MutantFunction
classes.description: Holds a function pointer with pre-bound arguments for invocation.

classes.name: MutantLateObjectBind
classes.description: Variant of Mutant that binds to a pointer to a pointer for late object binding.

classes.name: MutantFunctor
classes.description: Wrapper acting as a functor to invoke MutantRunner objects.

methods.name: RunWithParams
methods.description: Executes the stored method or function with given parameters.

methods.name: CreateFunctor
methods.description: Factory functions to create MutantFunctor objects for methods and functions.
